data.exact_reserve_text: In 2016, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 0.7m on prior year reserves (2015:surplus GBP 1.2m). This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes of business.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall surplus of GBP 0.7 million on prior year reserves in 2016, indicating a release of reserves. This favorable development was primarily driven by better than expected claims experience in the casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes of business. The 2014 year of account closed with a profit, while the 2015 year of account was described as more difficult due to deteriorating pricing and increased expenses, though a significant US Casualty contract was commuted at a profit in that year.
